items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: he had the hot Savoy 5 with Johnny Sensi and Dodds and all them old fellas... I'd get every record he put out

ctx.x: See, but Rainey and then old Georgia Boyd lived right in the block not far from me on Perdita Street, right around the corner. See, I was on Roman between Badita and Perdita and George Boyd was right up. But who did you want to play like? Did you like Rene? Satchmo. You like Lewis? Lewis. That's after I put the drums down and got the trumpet. And when I got me some chops together, see, well, my mother had a combination, RCA Victor, a combination, and I'd buy everything. Now, I hung out at Morris Music Shop, he…
But you knew Lully before he left?
